title: Warm Velvety Ukrainian Wood Ear Mushrooms Skillet
description: A solo dinner dish featuring wood ear mushrooms in a bitter and velvety Ukrainian sauce, cooked to perfection in a skillet with a char-grill flavor, suitable for Jain-friendly diets.
instructions: Soak the dried wood ear mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain and slice them into thin strips.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the sliced wood ear mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the water, apple cider vinegar, and dried dill weed to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the mushrooms are tender.
Serve the warm velvety Ukrainian wood ear mushrooms skillet hot, garnished with additional dried dill weed if desired.
